lines.N1: A corner shop in Saigon. Two hundred products, a queue at the counter, and the owner's hands are never free. Reorders happen from memory, and often too late.
lines.N2: Before the hackathon, our project only synced supplier invoices. Now ShopVoice watches the shop: a morning briefing, a reorder plan that remembers the owner's rules, and nothing bought without a spoken yes.
lines.N3: A simulated Alexa+ experience, live on our hosted demo. The MCP calls appear on the right.
lines.N4: Under the hood: a standard MCP server over streamable HTTP, twelve voice-first tools on Postgres with row-level security, hosted on Render. Claude plans the calls, and the host keeps every confirmation token. The official MCP Inspector connects with a public, read-only judge token.
lines.N5: Vietnam has over a million corner shops. ShopVoice gives each one an agent that keeps watch, and our open-source kiotviet-mcp lets any KiotViet shop plug in. ShopVoice is open source, built during Build, Ship, Shape. Try it: the link is below.
